summary: Three boaters stranded in Brown's Canyon below Zoom Flume after their raft flipped late Thursday night; CCSAR-South was paged ~10:15 pm and CCSAR-North plus Colorado Parks and Wildlife River Rangers responded. A CPW ranger kayaked across the river to reach the stranded subjects; all three were ferried to river-left and shuttled out by ATV along the railroad tracks, with all SAR/CPW personnel out of the field by 3:15 am July 7. Uninjured.
location: Brown's Canyon, below Zoom Flume, Arkansas River
responding_agency: Chaffee County SAR-South, Chaffee County SAR-North, Colorado Parks and Wildlife River Rangers
notes: Incident date: 2023-07-06 Thursday-verified; HOTR article states "Thursday, July 6th" without year — year pinned via the Colorado Sun/KSUT Aug-10-2023 retrospective on the same incident (CPW ranger Jeff Hammond kayak rescue). Dedupe clean: no Chaffee rows 2023-07-01..10; id 2429 (2014-06-15 Browns Canyon) is a distinct older incident.
